prompt:
Hey, our on-call alerting pipeline is being set up and needs a single structured snapshot of the current gateway server's health. Please produce a file called `health_report.json` in the workspace.

The pipeline ingests this file and needs it to contain:
1. A complete breakdown of current system resource usage (CPU, RAM, disk, uptime) in structured numeric fields.
2. A boolean field `alerts_active` indicating whether any critical resource threshold is currently being exceeded right now on this server.
3. An `alert_messages` field listing the exact warning messages for any breached thresholds.
4. A `verbose_metrics` section with the current network traffic rates and disk I/O throughput.
5. The OpenClaw gateway's running status (port, version, PID, uptime).
6. The active AI model configuration including primary model and the full fallback chain.
7. Current session statistics.

The server health monitoring tool is already available in the workspace. Use it directly — do NOT use cached or estimated values. The pipeline will reject stale data.
